SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    sum(s.SalesAmount) AS total_sales,
    sumIf(s.SalesAmount, s.CustomerKey IN (
        SELECT CustomerKey
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        GROUP BY CustomerKey
        HAVING countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber) >= 2
    )) AS repeat_customer_sales,
    repeat_customer_sales * 100.0 / nullif(total_sales, 0) AS repeat_customer_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY repeat_customer_pct DESC
